requirements.title: Canonical lifecycle state
requirements.statement: Every identifiable active prospect must have a canonical lifecycle state.

requirements.title: Accountable next action
requirements.statement: Every actionable pipeline record must support an accountable next action.

requirements.title: Single lifecycle authority
requirements.statement: Shared lifecycle definitions must have one canonical authority.

requirements.title: Preserve original source
requirements.statement: Where source attribution is technically available, original source must not be silently overwritten by later activity.

requirements.title: Canonical enrolled definition
requirements.statement: A canonical operational definition of enrolled must exist before enrollment conversion reporting is considered authoritative.

requirements.title: Outcome goal
requirements.statement: The pipeline must support recording a graduate's intended post-graduation outcome.

requirements.title: Outcome stage distinctions
requirements.statement: Outcome tracking must distinguish meaningful stages rather than representing all employer activity as placement.

requirements.title: Defined advocacy process
requirements.statement: The pipeline must support a defined graduate/student feedback and advocacy process.

requirements.title: Completion handoff observability
requirements.statement: The learning journey must support an observable completion state and handoff to post-graduation outcomes.

requirements.title: Qualified attributable demand
requirements.statement: Demand-generation measurement must distinguish qualified attributable pipeline entrants from vanity activity where data permits.

requirements.title: Partner contribution observability
requirements.statement: Strategic channels must distinguish contacts, active relationships, and measurable pipeline contribution where applicable.

requirements.title: Keep PII outside GitHub
requirements.statement: Personally identifiable student/customer records must remain outside GitHub unless explicitly sanitized and authorized.

requirements.title: No builder self-certification
requirements.statement: A builder's completion claim is insufficient by itself to mark a requirement accepted.

requirements.title: Separate journey integration
requirements.statement: The complete customer journey must be tested separately from individual lane acceptance.
